# Bageo v1.2.0

- **Contacts in four lists**: contact, whitelist, blacklist and stall. Whitelisted callers can be put through to your own phone, always or only when it is urgent.
- **Console password.** Optional; it protects the web console and the API.
- **One-tap actions in notifications** on every channel: block, stall or whitelist a caller, accept or decline an appointment. Notifications no longer use emoji.
- **Scam detection**: local patterns for 12 countries, debt-collection and harassment calls are stalled too, and a scam-only demand (a code, ATM steps, gift cards) starts stalling at once.
- **AI errands** switch language only after the other side says a whole sentence in it.
- **Plainer console and guides** in every language.

## 繁體中文

- **聯絡人分四種名單**：一般、白名單、黑名單、陪聊。白名單來電可以轉到你的手機，一律轉或有急事才轉。
- **控制台密碼。** 可設可不設，保護網頁控制台和 API。
- **通知裡一鍵處理**，每個管道都有：把來電者加進黑名單、陪聊或白名單，接受或拒絕預約。通知不再有表情符號。
- **詐騙辨識**：內建 12 國在地話術，催收和騷擾電話也會陪聊；對方一要驗證碼、操作 ATM、點數卡這類東西就馬上陪聊。
- **AI 代打**要對方完整講一句別的語言才會換語言。
- **控制台和說明文件改成白話**，每種語言都是。

Full changes / 完整變更：[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/h4lo-void/bageo-call/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)
